input.body: We are writing to ask for a review of a $15.00 deduction on order UE-tf03c, dated 2026-11-05, which was deducted with the reason "missing item" (Garlic Naan). The order ticket lists Garlic Naan, which shows the item was part of the order as placed [UE-tf03c:ticket_lists_item]. We recognise that the ticket alone does not show how the order was packed. Our records show the order was ready at 20:33 and was picked up by the courier at 20:36, 3 minutes later [UE-tf03c:pickup_handoff]. This indicates the order was handed off promptly after it was prepared. Based on this, we respectfully request that the deduction be reviewed and, if possible, reversed. We are happy to provide any further information that would help.
